title: (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als (Senior) Marketplace Manager verantwortest du unsere Präsenz auf den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen Europas, strategisch wie operativ. Du hast Ownership für Performance, Profitabilität und Markenauftritt deiner Kanäle und entscheidest aktiv mit, wie wir TEVEO auf den Plattformen positionieren. Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marke und Plattform. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit E-Commerce, Operations, Marketing, Finance und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Community-Spirit auf jedem Marktplatz genauso anfühlt wie in unserem eigenen Shop. Wichtig: Das ist keine reine Strategie-Rolle. Du bist hands-on unterwegs, packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an und setzt deine Ideen eigenständig um, vom Produktfeed über die Kampagne bis zur SLA-Kennzahl. Dein Bereich als (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d): Strategie & Wachstum Du entwickelst unsere Marketplace-Strategie für Europa und setzt sie um: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und die Erschließung neuer Marktplätze und Länder. Du verantwortest die Umsatz- und Ergebnisziele deiner Kanäle (GMV, NMV, Deckungsbeitrag) und steuerst sie über klare KPIs wie Conversion, Retourenquote und Sichtbarkeit. Du bewertest Marktpotenziale, erstellst Business Cases für neue Plattformen und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für das Management ab. Du legst fest, welche Essentials wir dauerhaft listen und welche Drops exklusiv bleiben, und entwickelst Launchkonzepte je Marktplatz. Account- und Plattformsteuerung Du führst unsere Partnerschaften mit den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen eigenverantwortlich. Dazu gehören Jahresgespräche, Konditions- und Promotion-Verhandlungen und das Platzieren von Aktionen und Kampagnen. Du verantwortest die CXM- und SLA-Kennzahlen (On-Time, Return Time, Valid Tracking), erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und setzt Maßnahmen konsequent um. Du steuerst Feed- und Attributmanagement über unsere Middleware (Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä.) und treibst die Weiterentwicklung der Schnittstellen und Prozesse voran. Content, Visibility & Brand Experience Du bist Marken-Wächter auf allen Plattformen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Auftritt in Bildsprache, Texten, Pricing und Promotions. Du planst Kampagnen, Launches und Retail-Media-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit Marketing und steuerst die Budgets für Retail Media. Du optimierst Produktdaten, Content-Qualität und Conversion und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte sauber und performant ausgespielt werden. Operations & Data Du verantwortest Forecasting, Bestandsplanung und Replenishment für die Marktplätze in enger Abstimmung mit Operations. Du steuerst die Abläufe rund um Versand und Retouren, z. B. über Fulfillment- und Retourenprogramme der Plattformen oder eigene Carrier-Setups, und optimierst sie hinsichtlich Kosten und SLA-Erfüllung. Du baust das Marketplace-Reporting auf und aus und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Entscheidungen für Management und Finance. Partner & Dienstleister Du steuerst externe Partner und Dienstleister wie Agenturen und Middleware-Anbieter. Dein Profil Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, E-Commerce, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce- oder Marketplace-Management, idealerweise im Fashion- oder Sportswear-Umfeld; für die Senior-Rolle nachweisliche Verantwortung für einen Marktplatz-Kanal inklusive Umsatzzielen Fundiertes Know-how in Marktplatzprozessen, Fulfillment-Setups und Provisionsstrukturen; Erfahrung mit großen Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen ist ein großes Plus Sicherer Umgang mit Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä., Looker Studio und Excel/Sheets Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für die Balance aus Performance und Brand-Ästhetik Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gern selbst im Tagesgeschäft mit, statt nur zu delegieren, und setzt Dinge schnell und pragmatisch um Verhandlungsstärke und Souveränität im Umgang mit Plattformpartnern und internen Stakeholdern Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Warum wir? Deine Perspektiven: Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern Regelmäßige Feedback Gespräche und transparente Kommunikation Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen Unsere Benefits: Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss. Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus Wir entlasten dich bei den Betreuungskosten durch einen monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung – damit Familie und Beruf gut zusammenpassen. Flexibilität durch digitale Benefits Ob Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt. Fitness direkt im Haus Kein Zeitverlust – nutze unser hauseigenes Gym , um dich vor, während oder nach der Arbeit fit zu halten. Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte Sichere dir exklusive Vergünstigungen auf unsere Marken – mit satten Rabatten auf Produkte von TEVEO, fayn. und Meek & Hon. Kostenloses Laden von E-Autos An unserem Standort in Ansbach kannst du dein E-Fahrzeug bequem und kostenlos laden – nachhaltig und praktisch. Selbstverständlich ist für uns: Wasser, Kaffee und verschiedene Milchsorten in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Ansbach. Onboarding vor Ort: In den ersten zwei Monaten ermöglichen wir dir unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere Kultur persönlich kennenzulernen – so legen wir gemeinsam die Basis für die Zusammenarbeit in der Zukunft. Unser Home Office Modell: Ab dem dritten Monat hast du die Möglichkeit, einen Tag pro Woche im Home Office zu arbeiten. Ab dem 7. Monat hast du die Möglichkeit 2 Tage pro Woche im Home Office zu arbeiten. Die Lage der Home Office – Tage wirst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit deiner Führungskraft passend regeln – für eine optimale Work- Life Balance. Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn du dich in unserer Beschreibung wieder erkennst, Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden möchtest und Freude daran hast, mit deiner Leistung zu begeistern. Du koordinierst unser Team, verteilst Aufgaben, überwachst deren Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines und Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufträgen, kurzfristigen Änderungen und unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern den Überblick. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft, findest pragmatische Lösungen und packst bei Bedarf selbst mit an. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitalen Systeme, Auftragsdaten und Dokumentationen stets aktuell und ordentlich gepflegt sind. Du beantwortest Anfragen, berätst zu unseren Dienstleistungen, koordinierst Termine und findest Lösungen für individuelle Anliegen. raw.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

raw.title: Product Manager Energy Markets & Flexibility (m/f/d)
raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.

By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Your mission

  • Conceptualization & Expansion of Energy Market Solutions: Development and operational establishment of scalable models for balancing group management (BKM), direct marketing, and flexibility optimization for our C&I and enterprise customers with multi-site portfolios
  • Tech & Market interface: Close collaboration with our software and product teams to further develop our virtual power plant (Heartbeat AI Enterprise) – defining functional requirements for aggregation, dynamic flexibility bands, and schedule setpoints
  • Partner & Trading Management: Selection, integration, and ongoing management of external BKM and trading partners (e.g., algorithmic intraday trading companies, aggregators, transmission system operators)
  • Multi-Use Operating Models: Design of prioritization and operational logic for commercial battery storage systems (e.g., balancing UPS/backup priority, grid-charge-optimized peak shaving, and spot market arbitrage)
  • Risk & Schedule Management: Monitoring forecasting quality, balancing energy costs (reBAP), and schedule notifications to minimize financial risks in the balancing group
  • Regulatory Framing: Ensuring and implementing relevant energy industry regulations (e.g., mixed storage guidelines / MiSpeL, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) in customer contracts and system workflows
  • Sales Support: Support during enterprise customer pitches, creation of economic models, and design of revenue-sharing concepts (profit-split)

Your profile

  • Completed degree in energy economics, industrial engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in balancing group management (BKM), at a direct marketer, flexibility aggregator (VPP), or in short-term power trading (EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead / Intraday)
  • Sound understanding of the deployment and monetization of large-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems (BESS) as well as PV systems in the C&I segment
  • Solid knowledge of the German regulatory framework (StromNEV, EnWG, MaBiS, MiSpeL) and market communication processes
  • High affinity for software, IoT architectures, and API-driven data flows between edge gateways, VPP platforms, and trading systems
  • Strong analytical mindset, entrepreneurial drive, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
  • Business fluent in German and English, both spoken and written

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. What you'll be doing Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc. Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market. Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan. Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets. Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. Our humble expectations 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems. Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting. A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience. Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change. Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus. An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change. The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global. A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office. Next steps What to expect from our hiring process: Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process. If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today! Please submit your up-to-date resume in English.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. description: Beschreibung Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen. Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch. Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus. Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit. Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg. Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo: Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.   • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)

  • Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden: Großkunden, Fuhrparks, Werkstätten, Autohäuser oder Einzelkunden
  • Mitwirkung an Dienstplanung, Prüfausstattung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

  • Betrauung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur – gern auch von einer anderen Überwachungsorganisation, den Wechsel zur GTÜ begleiten wir
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
  • Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Team fachlich zu führen
  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch
  • Freude am Umgang mit Kunden und Kollegen
  • Bereitschaft zum Einsatz an unseren Standorten

Was noch fehlt, bauen wir gemeinsam auf

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

  • fachliche Weiterbildungen, z. B. zum Unterschriftsberechtigten des Technischen Dienstes oder zum Kfz-Sachverständigen (inkl. IfS-Zertifizierung)
  • In-House-Schulungen – keine Anreise nötig, flexible Terminplanung

Leistungen der Anstellung

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung bei der von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH
  • Grundgehalt ab 4.000 €/Monat (Vollzeit) – je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation mehr; mit wachsender Verantwortung entwickelt sich selbstverständlich auch Ihr Gehalt weiter

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. YOUR IMPACT As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection. You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines. You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems. Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware. Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments. HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems. Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology. Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care. The role Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people. As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next. This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target. Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish. Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips. The customer relationship through go-live and beyond Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides. After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop. Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales. How we deliver Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie . Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf. Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard. Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage , in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen. Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein. Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa. Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich . Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern und betreust den Prozess so, dass er nicht nur jede Woche besser wird, sondern dass wir jede Woche mehr Kunden bedienen können. Denn genau da stehen wir: Mehr Kunden wollen unser Produkt, als wir heute live nehmen können. Prozessbetreuung: Dein Bereich läuft, weil du ihn steuerst - von der Anmeldung bis zur Bestätigung durch den Netzbetreiber, inklusive der technischen Abstimmung, wenn etwas nicht passt. Expansion: Du hilfst dabei, den Rollout in neue Netzbetreibergebiete voranzutreiben - neue Regeln erschließen, im System abbilden, live bringen. Und damit neue Kunden. Produkt: Wenn etwas hakt oder du einen Impuls hast, baust du mit unserem Engineering-Team direkt die Lösung. Du gestaltest das Produkt aktiv mit - und skalierst damit unser Operations-Geschäft. Was du mitbringst Du studierst Ingenieurwissenschaften: Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ähnliches Du arbeitest dich schnell in unbekannte Themen ein Du treibst gerne eigene Bereiche voran, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten Ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail - du findest Fehler, die nicht auffallen Du bist in Berlin und kannst 20 h/Woche im Büro sein Von Netzanmeldungen musst du noch nie gehört haben. Das lernst du hier in zwei Wochen. Warum Voltir Mission: Netzanmeldung ist einer der größten Engpässe der deutschen Energiewende. Du bist dabei, ihn zu lösen. Domain-Wissen, das du sonst nirgendwo bekommst: Netzbetreiber-Prozesse, Marktstammdatenregister, VDE-Normen, die Arbeitsweise der größten Solar- und Wärmepumpen-Anbieter Europas - du siehst den Renewable-Energy-Markt von innen. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

 

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as a Working Student in Client Experience and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Support our clients: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

 

What you bring:

  • Fluent German communication skills (B2/C1), along with comfortable working proficiency in English This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets and AI tooling. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 6 months and based in Berlin.

 

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

 

Our Values:

raw.description:
Account Executive

EU GTM | London, United Kingdom

 
 

About the team

Join our high-energy team in London and help us bring smarter payment solutions to growing businesses across the UK and Europe. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower merchants by making payments simple, accessible, and hassle-free. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we're just getting started. As an Account Executive, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team driving growth and helping business owners with £50k+ in revenue access the tools they need to succeed.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Proactively identify and reach out to prospects via calls, emails, and social — you'll be the one starting the conversation
  • Build strong relationships by understanding the unique needs of each business and showing how SumUp can make a real difference
  • Go on-site to meet prospects and clients in person — building trust face-to-face and delivering demos that convert
  • Deliver value-driven product pitches and demos that help convert curiosity into commitment
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first outreach to deal closed
  • Track your performance, meet your goals, and continuously level up through feedback and data
  • Share insights, collaborate with your team, and help build an energised outbound culture in the office
 
 

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have 1–2 years of outbound sales or business development experience — and a drive to learn and grow fast in the role.
  • You're confident, curious, and comfortable with high-volume outreach (mostly phone-based).
  • You love solving problems and helping people.
  • You're results-driven and thrive on smashing targets.
  • You bring a positive, team-first attitude and enjoy celebrating wins with your colleagues.
  • Bonus: Experience in payment tech, SaaS, or hospitality tools is a big plus.
 
 

Why you should join SumUp

💸 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission — your earning potential grows with your success!

 

✅ A foot in the fintech door — work for a global brand that's scaling fast and be part of a mission-driven team with real impact

 

🏢 Office-first culture in Central London — collaborate face-to-face with a fun, supportive team and stay connected to the energy of live sales

 

📚 €2,000 annual learning budget — invest in your development with training, events, or courses that support your goals

 

🧘 Sabbatical after 3 years — take a well-earned 30-day break to reset or pursue something meaningful

 

🌍 Diverse and inclusive workplace — be part of a team that values different perspectives and creates space for everyone to thrive

 

🔗 Referral bonus — help grow the team by referring talented friends or former colleagues and get rewarded for it

 
 

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

 

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

 

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

 
 

Keywords: Account Executive, Sales Executive, Inside Sales, Outbound Sales, Sales Representative, Business Development, Sales Consultant, Key Account Executive, B2B Sales, SMB Sales, Fintech Sales, London

description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.   Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.  As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle. You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch. The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together. Responsibilities Functional and system testing Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing. Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations. Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports. Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health. Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing. Verification tracking Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design. Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign. Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones. Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance. GSE and test infrastructure Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes. Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor. Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware. Integration and campaign support Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures. Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign. Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing. Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions. Requirements Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience. Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering. Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems. Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components. raw.title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
raw.description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

  • Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

  • Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

  • Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

  • Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

Verification tracking

  • Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

  • Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

  • Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

  • Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE and test infrastructure

  • Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

  • Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

  • Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

Integration and campaign support

  • Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

  • Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

  • Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

  • Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

Requirements

  • Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

  • Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

  • Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads.

  • Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment.

  • Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out.

  • Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers.

  • Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS).

  • Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs.

Desirables

  • End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch.

  • Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000).

  • Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC).

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents.

  • Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace).

  • Launch campaign experience at a launch site.

  • Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling.

  • Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme.

Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked.

  • Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware.

  • Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure.

  • Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace.

  • Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

description: About the Role: Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels. You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation. We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed. Tasks Day to day this looks like: Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs. Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community. Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment. Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs. Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel. Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth. Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches. Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy. Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works. Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy. Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business. Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience. Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets. Requirements You should: Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand. Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach. Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth. Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn. Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations. Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel. Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>Experience Without Limits</strong><br><strong>Come shape the future of brand experience.</strong></h3> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>At Jack Morton, we design and build<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong>head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>unlock the full value of experiences</strong>&nbsp;by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one.</strong>&nbsp;We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.</p></div><p>The Account Executive will support the assigned Account Management team and a portfolio of clients. This role will be responsible for supporting this team throughout the event sales process from project inception through to event delivery. We are looking for a highly detail orientated person to support the Account Management team with the day to day running of their accounts. This person should be well organised, have a keen eye for numbers and be highly computer literate, adept at using software platforms including Microsoft Office, CRM’s and finance platforms.</p> title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy &amp; Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy &amp; Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement &amp; Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting &amp; Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products &amp; Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.</p> <p>• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement &amp; Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.</p> <p><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <p>• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity</p> <p>• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences</p> <p>• Commercially minded</p> <p>• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels</p> <p>• Naturally curious and innovative</p> <p>• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader</p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications &amp; Skills:</strong></p> <p>• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams</p> <p>• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing</p> <p>• Experience leading teams and developing talent</p> <p>• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing</p> <p>• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)</p> <p>• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics</p> <p>• SQL and data querying experience preferred</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?</strong></p> <p>Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.</p> <p><strong>AP PERKS &amp; BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>100% remote work for everyone&nbsp;</li> <li>Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)&nbsp;</li> <li>401K with matching&nbsp;</li> <li>Open Paid Time Off&nbsp;</li> <li>Summer &amp; Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteer and Birthday Time Off&nbsp;</li> <li>Focus Fridays&nbsp;</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave Benefits&nbsp;</li> <li>Wellness, Technology &amp; Education Allowances&nbsp;</li> <li>Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!&nbsp;</li> <li>Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.</em></p> <p> &nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE &nbsp;</p> <p><em>*GLSDR</em>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-MG1&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p>Datadog’s Implementation Services team helps customers implement and deploy Datadog quickly.
