title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
description: <h4><strong>About the job</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.<br>Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.<br><br>You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.<br><br>You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.</p> <h4><strong>The team and culture</strong></h4> <p>The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.</p> <h4><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h4> <h4>Essential skills:</h4> <ul> <li>Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.</li> <li>The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.</li> <li>Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.</li> <li>Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.</li> <li>Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.</li> <li>Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.</li> <li>Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.</li> <li>Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong> Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong> Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong> Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong> Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br><br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><br><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></h4> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.<br><br>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.<br><br>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<br><br>Ready to shape the libraries developers use to build and run accelerator workloads? Apply to join Graphcore’s AI Compute Libraries team in Bristol.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.</p> <p>Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting &amp; Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.</p> <p>Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture&nbsp;and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don't&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;closed a&nbsp;$1 billion&nbsp;funding round that valued the company at&nbsp;$7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative,&nbsp;PsiQuantum's&nbsp;most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including&nbsp;Airbus,&nbsp;Lockheed&nbsp;Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have&nbsp;the funding,&nbsp;the government&nbsp;validation, and&nbsp;the sites&nbsp;under construction to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1">PsiQuantum is seeking a Senior Quantum Algorithms Researcher to join the Quantum Algorithms team within our Applications Development department. This role offers the opportunity to help define how large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers will be applied to consequential real-world problems in chemistry, pharmaceuticals, and materials science.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="449">At PsiQuantum, we believe in the transformative potential of quantum computing to solve problems beyond the reach of classical computation. For the first quantum computers to be useful, we believe they must be fault tolerant.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="677">This conviction shapes our approach to applications research. Rather than developing algorithms for near-term or intermediate-scale devices, we focus on quantum algorithms designed for the fault-tolerant regime, where, specifically, the cost of a quantum algorithm is determined by its runtime on a fusion-based, fault-tolerant quantum computer built on silicon photonic hardware.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1060">In the Quantum Algorithms team, we adapt and develop quantum algorithms, scope and identify promising use cases, and analyze resource requirements. In your role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract specifications for quantum algorithms, analyze their asymptotic performance, and help define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit instantiations of these algorithms and understand their resource requirements on our architecture.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1642">We are particularly interested in candidates with deep expertise in quantum simulation. This requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3167">The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a strong collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, evaluating the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and resource estimate.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience/Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">8+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. Too many sponsorships end at logo placement; at VML Live, that’s where our work begins.</p> <p>As a <strong>Senior Strategist (Sport &amp; Entertainment)</strong>, you will sit at the vital intersection of <strong>brand strategy, commercial rights, and multi-channel comms planning</strong>. Operationally Astute:</strong> You understand rights contracts, sponsorship mechanics, and production realities—ensuring your strategic visions are both ambitious and executable.</li> <li><strong>A Collaborative Leader:</strong> You thrive in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments and enjoy mentoring junior team members while holding your own with senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why VML Live?</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Unrivalled Scale &amp; Flexibility:</strong> We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible hybrid working policies, and dedicated career development pathways.</li> </ul> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. From shaping brand experiences to designing connected customer journeys, we believe the best work happens when different perspectives and capabilities come together.</p> <p>We're now looking for a Senior CX Strategist to join our London strategy team.</p> <h2>The Opportunity</h2> <p>Most brands don't have a communications problem. They have an experience problem. A gap between what they promise and what customers actually experience at the moments that matter.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior CX Strategist who can help close that gap.</p> <p>Someone who understands that great customer experience isn't just about individual touchpoints, CRM campaigns or digital journeys. It's about connecting the entire customer experience, from the first interaction with a brand through to building long-term relationships, loyalty and advocacy.</p> <p>You'll bring together <strong>CX, CRM and brand-level thinking</strong>, using customer insight, creativity and data to develop strategies that make experiences better for customers and more effective for businesses.</p> <p>You'll work across a range of exciting clients, including major global brands, helping them understand their customers, identify opportunities and create more connected, meaningful experiences.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of a business challenge, asking the right questions and turning complex customer problems into clear, inspiring strategic thinking.</p> bigger picture but isn't afraid to get into the detail.</p> <h2>What You'll Be Doing</h2> <h3>Connecting Brand, CX and CRM</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Develop integrated customer experience and valuable experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bring together brand strategy, CRM, digital experiences and customer engagement to create joined-up strategic thinking.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understand how different channels and touchpoints work together, from brand communications and social to digital, commerce, CRM and physical experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help clients move beyond individual campaigns and channels to think about the wider customer relationship.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Turning Insight into Strategy</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Use customer research, behavioural insights, data and market understanding to uncover meaningful opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Map customer journeys, identify pain points and understand the moments that matter most.</p> </li> <li> <p>Translate complex business and customer challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling creative briefs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop customer propositions, experience principles and strategic frameworks that inspire creative and experience design teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Challenge existing thinking and bring fresh perspectives to how brands engage with their customers.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Making Customer Experience More Effective</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Work closely with data and analytics teams to understand customer behaviour and identify opportunities for growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop strategies that improve customer acquisition, engagement, retention, loyalty and lifetime value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understand how to measure the effectiveness of recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use performance insights to identify what's working, what isn't and where experiences can be improved.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Bringing Strategy to Life</h3> <ul description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them. This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. raw.title: Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer
raw.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer to join our Digital Security team, and make security a built-in quality of everything we ship across the XTM platform (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, XTM One, XTM Hub). You'll work closely with the R&D team: the VP, Staff and Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Owners and the Product Manager. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them.

This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. And of course, you still code: critical security fixes, PR reviews, pair programming and the shared security components that make the secure path the easy one.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

  • Advise the CISO on product security strategy across the XTM platform, and lead its operational implementation in the product teams: turn priorities into concrete actions, and track security technical pains to resolution.

  • Lead threat modeling and security reviews in feature refinements with Product Owners: authentication and RBAC, multi-tenancy, connectors, the GraphQL API, and AI and agent features.

  • Ensure the security quality of the stack through critical PRs, fixes and code reviews, and build shared, secure-by-default components (authorization, secrets, safe outbound calls, input handling).

  • Drive secure SDLC and supply chain tooling in CI (SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning, Renovate, Snyk, SBOMs, signed releases), tuned so teams trust the results.

  • Run product vulnerability management: intake from the open source community, researchers and bug bounty, coordinated disclosure, CVEs and advisories, remediation SLAs, and the product side of security incidents.

  • Mentor engineers and grow security champions through pairing, workshops and continuous feedback. Document security architecture decisions so they stay consistent across teams.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports to: the CISO, as part of the Digital Security team.

  • Key collaborators: the R&D team, including Staff and Principal Engineers and Engineering Managers across the product teams, and Product Owners during refinements, Platform Engineering on infrastructure, compliance (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRamp) and incidents, and Customer Success on customer security questions and pentest findings.

  • Community: the OpenCTI and OpenAEV open source contributors and the security researchers who report vulnerabilities to us.

  • Mentorship: no direct reports. You'll act as the security technical reference and mentor for engineers across all teams, and grow a network of security champions.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in cybersecurity

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Master degreee in computer science and or cybersecurity with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and application or product security, including at least 3 years as the security technical reference for a SaaS or enterprise product

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong engineering and security skills: you write production code fluently in at least two of Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Rust, and you know web and API security in depth (GraphQL, OIDC/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, SSRF, injection), CI/CD security tooling, and container and Kubernetes security

  • A track record of influence without authority: you led a cross-team security initiative, coached engineers, and got standards adopted with pragmatism and clear priorities

  • Autonomy, ownership, and team spirit

  • Bonus: AI and LLM security (prompt injection, agent permissions), open source contributions or published CVEs, bug bounty program experience, knowledge of STIX 2.1 / MITRE ATT&CK or hands-on use of OpenCTI or OpenAEV

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our first Designer on Parallel’s design: the app used every day by hospital coding teams, as well as the brand. You’ll work daily with Product Managers, Engineers and the Ops team.

You’ll work on complex, domain-specific topics, with demanding users.

Your mission

  • Own product improvements end to end, including some product management: understand the need, frame and define the problem, prioritize, design the solution, then follow it through to production. You own the whole chain, from the need to delivery.

  • Design the app’s interfaces, from user flows to final UI.

  • Prototype quickly, including by coding with tools like Claude or Cursor when that’s the most efficient way.

  • Push code to production.

  • Contribute to branding.

Who you are

  • You have 4 to 7 years of experience.

  • You have experience as a strongly product-minded Product Designer, gained in a B2B SaaS startup or scale-up.

  • You have high standards for the visual quality of interfaces.

  • You can take on product management topics.

  • You want to work on the brand as well.

  • You use tools like Claude or Cursor to speed up your work.

Our values

  • Play to Win: we don’t aim for “good enough”. We go for results, move fast and fully commit when it matters.

  • High Trust, High Standards: trust is our starting point. The more autonomy we give, the higher the bar.

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: no one is above the work that needs doing, whatever their title or experience.

  • Don’t Take Yourself Too Seriously: we take our mission very seriously, without taking ourselves too seriously.

 

Hiring process

  1. First call with the recruiting team (30 min)

  2. Interview with Théo, about your portfolio or past experience (30 min)

  3. Case study and meetings at our Paris office

  4. Reference checks

  5. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

  • A role that shapes the product: your work goes straight into the app hospitals use.

  • Competitive compensation: salary and equity (BSPCE).

  • A great place to work: bright offices in Paris, regular team moments and two offsites a year.

  • Full benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport coverage, training and wellbeing budgets.

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems

  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

title: Mid Market Sales Manager (Paris)
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The role We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time. You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers. You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals. What you’ll do Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution. Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early. Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs. Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion. Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence. Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs. Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels. Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured. Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion. Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach. What we’re looking for A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed. Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs. A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage. Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices. Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth. Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams. High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style. Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important. What success looks like The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

title: FTTH Security Expert
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security , OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing. Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America. The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/). We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on. Job Description If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together. What you will do Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment. PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned. CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws. Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers. Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines. Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base. Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting. The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks. Preferred Qualifications Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial) MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment. Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications. Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure. Relevant certifications, such as: OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED GPEN / GXPN / GRID CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings) Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices. If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security! Language requirements English - fluent speaker French - optional Further details 🏢 Headquarters : Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE 🏠 Remote policy: At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Specialisations Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. Évaluer la performance et le comportement du produit selon les configurations et cas d'usage cliniques. Planifier, concevoir et exécuter les activités d'intégration et validation du logiciel d'imagerie médicale selon IEC 62304 et exigences réglementaires. Contribuer aux vérifications et validations fondées sur les risques, conformément à ISO 14971. Assurer la traçabilité entre exigences, risques, preuves de test et rapports de validation. Valider l'interopérabilité DICOM, l'échange, le stockage, le routage et la récupération d'images. Vérifier les procédures d'installation, configuration, mise à jour et déploiement logiciel. Reproduire et analyser les problèmes remontés par les clients dans des environnements intégrés. Analyser les défauts, mener des investigations et soutenir les actions correctives et préventives. Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet MSDIO, programme de recherche collaborative mené avec un industriel majeur du secteur des dispositifs ophtalmiques (Cristalens Industrie) et visant à développer un nouveau type de lentille intraoculaire (IOL) intégrant des métasurfaces pour la correction visuelle de nouvelle génération, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant en métasurfaces et optique visuelle au sein de notre département Optique.

Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Vincent Nourrit professeur àau département Optique d’IMT Atlantique et en collaboration avec Cristelens Industrie, vous prendrez en charge la modélisation et la simulation de fonctions de correction optique avancées (IOLs monofocaux, multifocaux ou commutables), le prototypage en salle blanche par photolithographie multiphotonique, ainsi que la caractérisation expérimentale des métasurfaces. Vous participerez également au développement d’outils logiciels dédiés et à la valorisation scientifique des résultats (publications, conférences).

Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée


✔️ Vous avez des compétences en modélisation de métasurfaces, simulation optique (Lumerical/Planopsim, Zemax) et idéalement en photolithographie.

✔️ Vous avez de l’expérience en conception optique et/ou fabrication en salle blanche, avec des connaissances souhaitables en optique et perception visuelles.

✔️ Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’initiative pour faire avancer le projet, et vous appréciez le travail en équipe

🎓 Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d'un Doctorat (obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche) en optique, photonique, physique ou domaine équivalent.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE :

🌊 Cadre de travail d'exception sur le campus de Brest au bord de l'océan, offrant une excellente qualité de vie.

🔬 Projet collaboratif innovant à fort impact médical et industriel, appuyé par des équipements de pointe (plateforme Arago).

🚀 Écosystème stimulant favorisant le développement scientifique, la valorisation et les opportunités de réseau.

LE PLUS :

🥗 Restauration collective sur place

🏃‍♀️ Offres de loisirs/sport

🚌 Prise en charge des transports en commun

🚴‍♂️ Forfait mobilité durable (pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo)

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Complément familial

💶 Large gamme de prestations sociales

title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. raw.description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

      • Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min)
      • Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min)
      • Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter
      • Rencontre avec les équipes
      • 2 prises de références
      • Offre

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end
